metadata.title: French Translation - Rachid Maach
metadata.description: Translated by Rashid Ma’ash

data.translation: Les pieux croyants, pour leur part, jouiront de tous les délices :
vergers luxuriants et vignes,
jeunes filles d’égale jeunesse,
coupes remplies de vin à volonté.

data.arabic_text: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا
data.translation: Là, ils n’entendront ni futilités, ni propos mensongers.
Récompense plus que suffisante accordée par ton Seigneur,

data.arabic_text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
data.translation: Seigneur des cieux, de la terre et de ce qui se trouve entre eux, le Tout Miséricordieux, auquel nul n’osera s’adresser.

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
data.translation: Ce Jour-là, l’Esprit[7] et les anges se tiendront en rangs et nul ne pourra prendre la parole[8] sauf celui qui en aura été autorisé par le Tout Miséricordieux et qui ne prononcera que des paroles de vérité.
data.footnotes:
[7] L’ange Gabriel, selon la majorité des commentateurs.
[8] Pour intercéder, expliquent nombre d’exégètes.

data.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
data.translation: Ce Jour arrivera inéluctablement ! Que celui qui le désire revienne donc à son Seigneur.

data.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
data.translation: Nous vous avons mis en garde contre un châtiment imminent, le Jour où l’homme verra ses œuvres et où le mécréant s’exclamera : « Si seulement je n’étais que poussière ! »

metadata.title: Spanish Translation - Isa Garcia
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Isa Garcia

data.translation: 31. En cambio, los piadosos obtendrán la bienaventuranza[1]
data.footnotes: [1] El Paraíso.

data.translation: 32. donde habrá huertos y vides,
33. doncellas de firmes senos y eterna juventud,
34. y copas desbordantes.

data.arabic_text: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا
data.translation: 35. Allí no oirán banalidades ni mentiras.
36. Esta es la recompensa de tu Señor, que concederá generosamente.

data.arabic_text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
data.translation: 37. El Señor de los cielos, de la Tierra y de lo que hay entre ellos, el Compasivo. Nadie puede hablar ante Él excepto con Su permiso.

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
data.translation: 38. El día en que el Espíritu[1] junto con los demás ángeles se pongan en fila, nadie hablará, salvo aquel a quien el Compasivo se lo permita, y solo podrá decir la verdad.
data.footnotes: [1] El ángel Gabriel.

data.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
data.translation: 39. Ese es el día de la verdad absoluta [en que se establecerá total justicia]. Quien quiera, entonces, que busque refugio en Su Señor.

data.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
data.translation: 40. Les he advertido de este castigo inminente. Ese día cada ser humano ha de contemplar sus obras, y entonces dirá quien haya desmentido el Mensaje: “¡Ojalá fuera polvo [para no ser juzgado]!”

metadata.title: Turkish Translation - Dr. Ali Ozek and others
metadata.description: Translated by Ali Ozek and others, developed under the supervision of Rowad Translation Center. The original translation is available for expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Şüphesiz takvâ sahipleri için umulanı buldukları yer,
bahçeler, üzüm bağları,
göğüsleri tomurcuk gibi kabarmış yaşıt kızlar,
içki dolu kâseler vardır.

data.arabic_text: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا
data.translation: Onlar orada ne boş bir lâkırdı ne de yalan işitirler.
Bunlar Rabbinin yeterli bir bağışı, mükâfatıdır.

data.arabic_text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
data.translation: O, göklerin, yerin ve ikisi arasında bulunanların Rabbidir. O, rahmândır. O gün insanlar O'na karşı konuşmaya yetkili değillerdir.

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
data.translation: Ruh (Cebrail) ve melekler saf saf olup durduğu gün, Rahmân’ın izin verdiklerinden başkaları konuşmazlar; konuşan da doğruyu söyler.

data.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
data.translation: İşte o, kesin olarak gelecek gündür. O halde dileyen Rabbine varan bir yol tutsun.

data.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
data.translation: Biz, yakın bir azap ile sizi uyardık. O gün kişi önceden yaptıklarına bakacak ve inkârcı kişi: «Keşke toprak olsaydım!» diyecektir.

metadata.title: Bosnian Translation - Muhammad Mahanovic
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Mahanovic, developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center. The original translation is available for the purpose of expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Zaista bogobojaznima mjesto spasa i uživanja pripada:
bašče i vinogradi,
i djevice čvrstih grudi, godina istih,
i pehari puni.

data.arabic_text: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا
data.translation: Tamo prazne besjede i laži neće slušati,
to im je nagrada od Gospodara tvoga, dar dovoljni.

data.arabic_text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
data.translation: Od Gospodara nebesa i Zemlje i onoga što je između njih, Svemilosnoga, kome neće moći zboriti.

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
data.translation: Na Dan kada Duh i meleci budu u redove poredani, oni neće govoriti. Govorit će samo onaj kome Svemilosni dozvoli, a istinu će reći.

data.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
data.translation: To je Istiniti dan, pa ko hoće, povratak Gospodaru svome prihvatit će.

data.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
data.translation: Mi vas, zaista, na patnju blisku upozoravamo, na Dan u kome će čovjek djela ruku svojih vidjeti, a nevjernik uzviknuti: "Kamo sreće da sam prašina bio!"

metadata.title: German Translation - Frank Bubenheim
metadata.description: Translated by ‘Abdullah as-Sāmit (Frank Bubenheim) and Dr. Nadim Elias.

data.translation: Gewiß, für die Gottesfürchtigen wird es einen Ort des Erfolgs geben,
umfriedete Gärten und Rebstöcke
und prächtige, gleichaltrige (weibliche Wesen)
und ein (stets) voller Becher.

data.arabic_text: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا
data.translation: Weder hören sie darin unbedachte Rede noch Lüge.
(Dies) als Belohnung von deinem Herrn, als hinreichende Gabe,

data.arabic_text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
data.translation: dem Herrn der Himmel und der Erde und dessen, was dazwischen ist, dem Allerbarmer. Sie verfügen nicht darüber, vor Ihm zu reden,

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
data.translation: am Tag, da der Geist und die Engel in Reihe stehen. Sie werden nicht sprechen, außer wem der Allerbarmer es erlaubt und wer Richtiges sagt.

data.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
data.translation: Das ist der wahrhaftig (eintreffend)e Tag. Wer nun will, nimmt zu seinem Herrn eine Heimkehr.

data.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
data.translation: Wir warnen euch ja vor naher Strafe, am Tag, da der Mensch schauen wird, was seine Hände vorausgeschickt haben, und der Ungläubige sagen wird: O wäre ich doch Erde!

metadata.title: English Translation - Noor International Center
metadata.description: Issued by Noor International Center.

data.translation: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment[1826] -
data.footnotes: [1826] Of security, success and reward, including escape and safety from Hell.

data.translation: Gardens and grapevines
And young women [companions] of equal age.
And a full cup.[1827]
data.footnotes: [1827] Of wine which is delicious and does not intoxicate.

data.arabic_text: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا
data.translation: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
[As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,[1828]
data.footnotes: [1828] i.e., as a result of both their own righteous deeds and the limitless generosity of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) . Another meaning is "a gift calculated [to be adequate]."

data.arabic_text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
data.translation: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.[1829]
data.footnotes: [1829] None of Allāh's creatures can plead with Him on the Day of Judgement except by His permission.

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
data.translation: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

data.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
data.translation: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.[1830]
data.footnotes: [1830] i.e., a direct route through correct beliefs and righteous deeds.

data.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
data.translation: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth[1831] and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
data.footnotes: [1831] i.e., the deeds he did in this world, which await him in the Hereafter.

metadata.title: English Translation - Noor International Center
metadata.description: Issued by Noor International Center.

data.translation: By the morning brightness
And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,[1941]
data.footnotes: [1941] And becomes still.

data.translation: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you].
And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
And He found you lost and guided [you],
And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
And as for the petitioner,[1942] do not repel [him].
data.footnotes: [1942] Anyone who seeks aid or knowledge.

data.translation: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].

metadata.title: Spanish Translation - Isa Garcia
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Isa Garcia

data.translation: 1. Juro por el resplandor matinal,
2. por la noche cuando se serena,
3. que tu Señor no te ha abandonado ni aborrecido [¡Oh, Mujámmad!].
4. La vida del más allá será mejor para ti que esta.
5. Tu Señor te agraciará y te complacerás.
6. ¿Acaso no te encontró huérfano y te dio amparo,
7. y te encontró perdido y te guió,
8. y te encontró pobre y te enriqueció?
9. Por eso, no maltrates al huérfano
10. ni rechaces al mendigo.
11. Y divulga las bendiciones de tu Señor.

metadata.title: Turkish Translation - Dr. Ali Ozek and others
metadata.description: Translated by Ali Ozek and others, developed under the supervision of Rowad Translation Center. The original translation is available for expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Kuşluk vaktine yemin ederim ki
ve sükuna erdiğinde geceye yemin ederim ki
Rabbin seni bırakmadı ve sana darılmadı.
Gerçekten senin için ahiret dünyadan daha hayırlıdır.
Pek yakında Rabbin sana verecek de hoşnut olacaksın .
O, seni yetim bulup barındırmadı mı?
Şaşırmış bulup da yol göstermedi mi?
Seni fakir bulup zengin etmedi mi?
Öyleyse yetimi sakın ezme.
El açıp isteyeni de sakın azarlama.
Ve Rabbinin nimetini minnet ve şükranla an.

metadata.title: German Translation - Frank Bubenheim
metadata.description: Translated by ‘Abdullah as-Sāmit (Frank Bubenheim) and Dr. Nadim Elias.

data.translation: Bei der Morgenhelle
und der Nacht, wenn sie (alles) umhüllt!
Dein Herr hat sich weder von dir verabschiedet noch haßt Er (dich).
Und das Jenseits ist wahrlich besser für dich als das Diesseits.
Und dein Herr wird dir wahrlich geben, und dann wirst du zufrieden sein.
Hat Er dich nicht als Waise gefunden und (dir) dann Zuflucht verschafft
und dich irregehend gefunden und dann rechtgeleitet
und dich arm gefunden und dann reich gemacht?
Was nun die Waise angeht, so unterjoche (sie) nicht,
und was den Bettler angeht, so fahre (ihn) nicht an,
und was die Gunst deines Herrn angeht, so erzähle (davon).

metadata.title: French Translation - Rachid Maach
metadata.description: Translated by Rashid Ma’ash

data.translation: Par le jour qui répand sa clarté !
Par la nuit qui étend son obscurité !
Ton Seigneur ne t’a ni abandonné, ni détesté.
L’au-delà te réserve une plus grande félicité.
Ton Seigneur t’accordera de quoi te combler.
Ne t’a-t-Il pas, te trouvant orphelin, entouré d’attentions ?
Ne t’a-t-Il pas, te trouvant ignorant, enseigné la vraie foi ?
Ne t’a-t-Il pas, te trouvant démuni, placé au-dessus du besoin ?
Prends donc garde de traiter durement l’orphelin
ou de repousser le mendiant sans nul ménagement.
Et proclame les grâces de ton Seigneur hautement !

metadata.title: Dutch Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
metadata.description: Issued by the Dutch Islamic Center and developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center

data.translation: Bij de ochtendgloren.
En de pikdonkere nacht wanneer die valt.
Jouw Heer heeft je niet verlaten en noch haat hij jou (dus wanhoop nooit en blijf standvastig).
En zeker is het hiernamaals beter voor jou dan het eerste.
En waarlijk, jouw Heer zal je (onvoorwaardelijk van Zijn gunsten) geven zodat je tevreden zult zijn.
Heeft Hij jou niet als wees gevonden en een bescherming gegeven?
En vond Hij je dwalend (zonder leiding, kennis) en heeft jou geleid?
En heeft Hij je niet arm gevonden en je rijk gemaakt?
Onderdruk daarom de wees niet.
En snauw de bedelaar niet af.
En verkondig de gunsten van je Heer.

metadata.title: Turkish Translation - Dr. Ali Ozek and others
metadata.description: Translated by Ali Ozek and others, developed under the supervision of Rowad Translation Center. The original translation is available for expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Biz senin göğsünü açıp genişletmedik mi?
yükünü senden alıp atmadık mı?
Belini büken
Senin şânını ve ününü yüceltmedik mi?
Elbette zorluğun yanında bir kolaylık vardır.
Gerçekten, zorlukla beraber bir kolaylık daha vardır.
Boş kaldın mı hemen başka işe koyul
ve yalnız Rabbine yönel.

metadata.title: Bosnian Translation - Muhammad Mahanovic
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Mahanovic, developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center. The original translation is available for the purpose of expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Tako mi jutra
i noći kad se utiša,
Gospodar tvoj nije te ni napustio ni omrznuo!
Ahiret je, zaista, bolji za tebe od ovog svijeta,
a Gospodar tvoj će tebi sigurno dati, pa ćeš zadovoljan biti.
Zar te siročetom ne nađe, pa ti utočište dade,
i zalutalim te nađe, pa te uputi,
i siromahom te nađe, pa te bogatim učini?
Zato, siroče ne okahari,
i onoga ko traži ne odbij,
i o blagodati Gospodara svoga kazuj!

metadata.title: German Translation - Frank Bubenheim
metadata.description: Translated by ‘Abdullah as-Sāmit (Frank Bubenheim) and Dr. Nadim Elias.

data.translation: Haben Wir dir nicht deine Brust aufgetan
und dir deine Last abgenommen,
die deinen Rücken niederdrückte,
und dir dein Ansehen erhöht?
Also gewiß, mit der Erschwernis ist Erleichterung,
gewiß, mit der Erschwernis ist Erleichterung.
Wenn du nun fertig bist, dann strenge dich an
und nach deinem Herrn richte dein Begehren aus.

metadata.title: Spanish Translation - Isa Garcia
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Isa Garcia

data.translation: 1. ¿Acaso no he dado sosiego a tu corazón [¡Oh, Mujámmad!],
2. te he liberado de la carga
3. que agobiaba tu espalda[1],
data.footnotes: [1] Referencia a los pecados anteriores a recibir la revelación.

data.translation: 4. y he elevado tu renombre?
5. Con toda dificultad viene una facilidad.
6. Realmente, con toda dificultad viene una facilidad.
7. Cuando cumplas con tus obligaciones dedícate a la adoración,
8. y a tu Señor anhela con devoción.

metadata.title: English Translation - Noor International Center
metadata.description: Issued by Noor International Center.

data.translation: Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?[1944]
data.footnotes: [1944] i.e., enlighten, assure and gladden your heart with guidance.

data.translation: And We removed from you your burden[1945]
data.footnotes: [1945] By forgiving any errors which you may have committed previously or might commit consequently. "Burden" can also refer to the anxiety experienced by the Prophet (ﷺ) at the beginning of his mission.

data.translation: Which had weighed upon your back
And raised high for you your repute.
For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief].
Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

metadata.title: Turkish Translation - Dr. Ali Ozek and others
metadata.description: Translated by Ali Ozek and others, developed under the supervision of Rowad Translation Center. The original translation is available for expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: İncire, zeytine, yemin ederim ki,
Sina dağına yemin ederim ki
ve şu emîn beldeye yemin ederim ki,

data.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
data.translation: biz insanı en güzel biçimde yarattık.
Sonra onu aşağıların aşağısına indirdik.

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
data.translation: Fakat iman edip sâlih amel işleyenler için eksilmeyen devamlı bir ecir vardır.
Artık bundan sonra, ceza günü konusunda seni kim yalanlayabilir?
Allah, hüküm verenlerin en üstünü değil midir?

metadata.title: Dutch Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
metadata.description: Issued by the Dutch Islamic Center and developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center

data.translation: Hebben Wij je hart dan niet voor jou verruimt (met het profeetschap, het geloof en wijsheid)?
En je lasten niet verlicht?
Die jouw rug verzwaarde.
En je roem hoog doen rijzen?
Dus waarlijk, na ongemak komen er weer betere tijden.
Waarlijk, na ongemak komen er weer betere tijden.
Dus wanneer je klaar ben met jouw bezigheden streef dan verder in aanbidding.
En richt je streven (puur alleen) naar jouw Heer.

metadata.title: Bosnian Translation - Muhammad Mahanovic
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Mahanovic, developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center. The original translation is available for the purpose of expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Zar grudi tvoje nismo prostranim učinili
i breme tvoje skinuli,
koje je pleća tvoja pritiskalo,
i spomen na tebe visoko uzdigli!
Pa, zaista, s mukom je olakšanje,
zaista, s mukom je olakšanje!
A kad završiš, molitvi se predaj,
i Gospodaru svome teži!

metadata.title: Dutch Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
metadata.description: Issued by the Dutch Islamic Center and developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center

data.translation: Waarlijk voor de godvrezenden die Allah vreest, zal er succes zijn.
Tuinen en wijngaarden.
En gezellinnen die een gelijke leeftijd hebben.
En een volle beker.

data.arabic_text: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا
data.translation: Zij zullen daar geen nutteloos gepraat horen, noch een leugen.
Een beloning van jullie Heer, een beloning die meer dan voldoet.

data.arabic_text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
data.translation: (Van) de Heer van de hemelen en de aarde en wat daar tussen is – de meest Barmhartige niemand durft met Hem te spreken (op de dag der opstanding) behalve met Zijn permissie.

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
data.translation: De dag dat Jibriel en de engelen in rijen zullen staan zal, niemand spreken behalve degene die de toestemming heeft van de meest Barmhartige en hij zal zeggen wat juist is.

data.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
data.translation: Dat is zonder twijfel de ware dag, laat dus iedereen die dat wil zich tot zijn Heer keren.

data.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
data.translation: Waarlijk, Wij hebben jullie gewaarschuwd voor een naderende bestraffing – de dag dat de mens zal zien wat zijn handen hebben voortgebracht (aan goed en slecht). En (radeloos) zal de ongelovige zeggen: “Wee mij! Werd ik maar tot stof herleid (zoals de dieren)!”

metadata.title: French Translation - Rachid Maach
metadata.description: Translated by Rashid Ma’ash

data.translation: N’avons-Nous pas épanoui ton cœur,
te soulageant ainsi de ce fardeau
qui pesait si lourdement sur ton dos ?
N’avons-Nous pas rehaussé ton renom ?
Sache qu’il n’est d’épreuve qui ne soit suivie d’une délivrance.
Oui, il n’est pas d’épreuve qui ne soit suivie d’une délivrance.
Une fois donc libéré de tes occupations, consacre-toi au culte avec ferveur,
te tournant sincèrement vers ton Seigneur, convoitant humblement Ses faveurs.

metadata.title: English Translation - Noor International Center
metadata.description: Issued by Noor International Center.

data.translation: By the fig and the olive[1947]
data.footnotes: [1947] Referring to the places known for their production, i.e., Damascus and Jerusalem, respectively. It could also refer to the fig and olive trees or to the fruits themselves.

data.translation: And [by] Mount Sinai
And [by] this secure city [i.e., Makkah],

data.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
data.translation: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;[1948]
data.footnotes: [1948] i.e., upright, symmetrical, and balanced in form and nature.

data.translation: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,[1949]
data.footnotes: [1949] This can refer to the depths of Hell, to decrepit old age or to immorality.

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
data.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?[1950]
data.footnotes: [1950] More literally, "What makes you lie concerning it?"

data.translation: Is not Allāh the most just of judges?

metadata.title: German Translation - Frank Bubenheim
metadata.description: Translated by ‘Abdullah as-Sāmit (Frank Bubenheim) and Dr. Nadim Elias.

data.translation: Bei der Feige und der Olive
und dem Berg Sinin
und dieser sicheren Ortschaft!

data.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
data.translation: Wir haben den Menschen ja in schönster Gestaltung erschaffen,
hierauf haben Wir ihn zu den Niedrigsten der Niedrigen werden lassen,

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
data.translation: außer denjenigen, die glauben und rechtschaffene Werke tun; für sie wird es einen Lohn geben, der nicht aufhört.
Was läßt dich da weiterhin das Gericht für Lüge erklären?
Ist nicht Allah der Weiseste derjenigen, die richten?

metadata.title: Turkish Translation - Dr. Ali Ozek and others
metadata.description: Translated by Ali Ozek and others, developed under the supervision of Rowad Translation Center. The original translation is available for expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Biz onu (Kur'an'ı) Kadir gecesinde indirdik.
Kadir gecesinin ne olduğunu sen bilir misin?

data.arabic_text: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
data.translation: Kadir gecesi, bin aydan hayırlıdır.

data.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
data.translation: O gecede, Rablerinin izniyle melekler ve Ruh (Cebrail), her iş için iner dururlar.
O gece, esenlik doludur. Ta fecrin doğuşuna kadar.

metadata.title: Spanish Translation - Isa Garcia
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Isa Garcia

data.translation: 1. Juro por la higuera y el olivo,
2. por el monte Sinaí,
3. y por esta ciudad segura [La Meca].

data.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
data.translation: 4. Que he creado al ser humano con la mejor conformación.
5. Sin embargo, [a quien rechace el Mensaje] lo degradaré al rango más bajo.

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
data.translation: 6. En cambio, a los creyentes que obran rectamente les tengo reservada una recompensa inagotable.
7. ¿Cómo puedes desmentir el Día del Juicio?
8. ¿Acaso no es Dios el más Justo de los jueces?

metadata.title: French Translation - Rachid Maach
metadata.description: Translated by Rashid Ma’ash

data.translation: Par le figuier et l’olivier !
Par le mont Sinaï !
Par cette cité sûre[1] !
data.footnotes: [1] Le « figuier et l’olivier » désignent, selon Ibn Kathîr, Jérusalem, ville où Jésus a prêché l’Evangile. Rappelons qu’une colline bien connue porte dans cette ville le nom de « mont des Oliviers ». Le « mont Sinaï » est le lieu où le Seigneur s’est adressé à Moïse. Quant à la « cité sûre », il s’agit de la Mecque, ville natale de Mouhammad où une partie du Coran - dont justement cette sourate - a été révélée. Le Seigneur jure donc ici par trois lieux hautement symboliques pour les trois religions révélées, lieux où s’est glorieusement manifestée Sa révélation.

data.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
data.translation: Nous avons créé l’homme en le dotant de la nature la plus pure[2],
data.footnotes: [2] Une nature le disposant à adorer son Seigneur sans Lui associer d’autres divinités. Allah dit par ailleurs : « Tourne-toi donc, en monothéiste pur et sincère, vers la vraie religion, la religion naturelle à laquelle Allah a prédisposé les hommes » (sourate 30, verset 30).

data.translation: avant de lui faire connaître la plus infâme déchéance[3].
data.footnotes: [3] En le laissant pervertir sa nature et renier son Créateur.

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
data.translation: A l’exception de ceux qui croient et accomplissent de bonnes œuvres, auxquels est réservée une récompense dont ils ne seront jamais privés.
Qu’est-ce qui peut, après cela, vous faire encore douter du Jugement dernier ?
Allah n’est-Il pas le plus équitable et le plus sage des juges ?

metadata.title: Spanish Translation - Isa Garcia
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Isa Garcia

data.translation: 1. Comencé la revelación [del Corán] en la noche de la predestinación.
2. ¿Y qué te hará comprender la importancia de la noche de la predestinación?

data.arabic_text: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
data.translation: 3. [Adorar a Dios] la noche de la predestinación es superior en recompensa a hacerlo durante mil meses.

data.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
data.translation: 4. Esta noche descienden los ángeles y el espíritu [el ángel Gabriel] con órdenes de su Señor para todos los asuntos.
5. Es una noche de paz y seguridad hasta el comienzo del alba.

metadata.title: French Translation - Rachid Maach
metadata.description: Translated by Rashid Ma’ash

data.translation: Nous l’avons révélé[1] au cours de la Nuit des décrets divins[2].
data.footnotes:
[1] Le Coran, dont la révélation a débuté au cours de cette nuit bénie.
[2] Connue comme étant la « Nuit du destin » et située au mois de Ramadan. Le terme arabe « Qadr » traduit ici par « décrets divins » revêt un second sens : il signifie que cette nuit est sublime et d’une très grande valeur.

data.translation: Mais qui pourrait t’indiquer ce qu’est la Nuit des décrets divins ?

data.arabic_text: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
data.translation: La Nuit des décrets divins est plus bénie que mille mois réunis[3].
data.footnotes: [3] Les œuvres accomplies lors de cette nuit sont plus méritoires que celles de mille mois.

data.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
data.translation: Porteurs de tous les arrêts divins[4], les anges et l’Esprit[5] descendent sur ordre de leur Seigneur au cours de cette nuit.
data.footnotes:
[4] Relatifs à l’année à venir, expliquent les commentateurs. Voir sourate 44, versets 3-5.
[5] L’ange Gabriel, selon la majorité des exégètes.

data.translation: C’est une nuit remplie de paix et de bénédiction jusqu’à l’apparition de l’aube.

metadata.title: Dutch Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
metadata.description: Issued by the Dutch Islamic Center and developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center

data.translation: Bij de vijg en de olijf.
Bij de berg Sinaï.
En bij deze veilige stad (Mekka).

data.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
data.translation: Waarlijk, Wij hebben de mens (Adam en zijn nageslacht) in de beste (en mooiste) vorm geschapen (en samengesteld).
Toen hebben Wij hem verlaagd tot het allerlaagste.

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
data.translation: Behalve degene die geloven en goede daden verrichten; zij zullen hun beloning hebben die eindeloos voortduurt.
Wat zorgt ervoor dat jullie de verrekening ontkennen?
Is Allah niet de beste Rechter?

metadata.title: Bosnian Translation - Muhammad Mahanovic
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Mahanovic, developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center. The original translation is available for the purpose of expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Mi smo ga objavili u Noći odredbe,
a šta ti misliš šta je Noć odredbe?

data.arabic_text: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
data.translation: Noć odredbe bolja je od hiljadu mjeseci;

data.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
data.translation: meleci i Duh, s dozvolom Gospodara svoga, spuštaju se u njoj zbog odluke svake,
spas je u njoj sve dok zora ne svane.

metadata.title: Turkish Translation - Dr. Ali Ozek and others
metadata.description: Translated by Ali Ozek and others, developed under the supervision of Rowad Translation Center. The original translation is available for expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Yeryüzü kendine has sarsıntısıyla sallandığı,
toprak ağırlıklarını dışarı çıkardığı
ve insan «Ne oluyor buna!» dediği vakit,
işte o gün (yer)  bütün haberlerini anlatır.
Rabbinin ona bildirmesiyle

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
data.translation: o gün insanlar amellerini görmeleri (karşılığını almaları) için darmadağınık geri dönüp gelirler.

data.arabic_text: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: Kim zerre miktarı hayır yapmışsa onu görür.

data.arabic_text: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: Kim de zerre miktarı şer işlemişse onu görür.

metadata.title: English Translation - Noor International Center
metadata.description: Issued by Noor International Center.

data.translation: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.
And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

data.arabic_text: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
data.translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

data.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
data.translation: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.[1955]
data.footnotes: [1955] Bringing the exact measures apportioned for everything by Allāh in the course of the coming year.

data.translation: Peace it is[1956] until the emergence of dawn.
data.footnotes: [1956] Upon the believers.

metadata.title: German Translation - Frank Bubenheim
metadata.description: Translated by ‘Abdullah as-Sāmit (Frank Bubenheim) and Dr. Nadim Elias.

data.translation: Wir haben ihn ja in der Nacht der Bestimmung hinabgesandt.
Und was läßt dich wissen, was die Nacht der Bestimmung ist?

data.arabic_text: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
data.translation: Die Nacht der Bestimmung ist besser als tausend Monate.

data.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
data.translation: Es kommen die Engel und der Geist in ihr mit der Erlaubnis ihres Herrn mit jeder Angelegenheit herab.
Frieden ist sie bis zum Anbruch der Morgendämmerung.

metadata.title: Dutch Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
metadata.description: Issued by the Dutch Islamic Center and developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center

data.translation: Waarlijk! Wij hebben de Koran in de nacht van de beschikking neergezonden.
En wat doet jou weten wat de nacht van de beschikking is?

data.arabic_text: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
data.translation: De nacht van de beschikking is beter dan duizend maanden.

data.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
data.translation: Daarin dalen met Allah Zijn toestemming de engelen neer en Jibriël met alle beschikkingen.
Vrede! Zij over deze nacht tot het verschijnen van de dageraad!

metadata.title: Bosnian Translation - Muhammad Mahanovic
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Mahanovic, developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center. The original translation is available for the purpose of expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Tako mi smokve i masline.
i Sinajske gore,
i grada ovog, sigurnog,

data.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
data.translation: Mi čovjeka stvaramo u najljepšem obliku,
zatim ćemo ga u najniže nizine vratiti.

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
data.translation: samo ne one koji budu vjerovali i dobra djela činili, njima pripada nagrada neprekidna.
Pa, šta te onda navodi da poričeš obračun?
Zar Allah nije sudija najpravedniji?!

metadata.title: German Translation - Frank Bubenheim
metadata.description: Translated by ‘Abdullah as-Sāmit (Frank Bubenheim) and Dr. Nadim Elias.

data.translation: Wenn die Erde erschüttert wird durch ihr heftiges Beben
und die Erde hervorbringt ihre Lasten
und der Mensch sagt: Was ist mit ihr?,
an jenem Tag wird sie die Nachrichten über sich erzählen,
weil dein Herr (es) ihr eingegeben hat.

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
data.translation: An jenem Tag werden die Menschen (in Gruppen) getrennt herauskommen, damit ihnen ihre Werke gezeigt werden.

data.arabic_text: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: Wer nun im Gewicht eines Stäubchens Gutes tut, wird es sehen.

data.arabic_text: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: Und wer im Gewicht eines Stäubchens Böses tut, wird es sehen.

metadata.title: English Translation - Noor International Center
metadata.description: Issued by Noor International Center.

data.translation: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
And the earth discharges its burdens[1962]
data.footnotes: [1962] See verse 84:4.

data.translation: And man says,[1963] "What is [wrong] with it?" -
data.footnotes: [1963] In terror and amazement.

data.translation: That Day, it will report its news
Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
data.translation: That Day, the people will depart[1964] separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
data.footnotes: [1964] From the place of Judgement to their final abode. Another interpretation is "emerge separately" (from the graves) .

data.arabic_text: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: So whoever does an atom's weight[1965] of good will see it,
data.footnotes: [1965] Or "the weight of a small ant."

data.arabic_text: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

metadata.title: Spanish Translation - Isa Garcia
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Isa Garcia

data.translation: 1. Cuando la Tierra sea sacudida por el gran terremoto,
2. y expulse su carga [haciendo surgir a los muertos de sus tumbas],
3. y el ser humano diga: “¿Qué le sucede a la Tierra?”
4. Ese día, la Tierra dará testimonio de todo cuanto sucedió sobre ella,
5. por orden de su Señor.

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
data.translation: 6. Entonces, los seres humanos acudirán al Día del Juicio en grupos para conocer el resultado de sus obras.

data.arabic_text: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: 7. Quien haya realizado una obra de bien, tan pequeña como un átomo, la encontrará registrada.

data.arabic_text: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: 8. Pero quien haya realizado una mala obra, tan pequeña como un átomo, también la encontrará registrada.

metadata.title: Bosnian Translation - Muhammad Mahanovic
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Mahanovic, developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center. The original translation is available for the purpose of expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Kad se Zemlja najžešćim potresom svojim zatrese,
i kada Zemlja izbaci terete svoje
i čovjek uzvikne: "Šta joj je?",
taj dan ona će vijesti svoje kazivati
jer će joj Gospodar tvoj dopustiti.

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
data.translation: Taj dan ljudi će se razdvojeni pojaviti da im se pokažu djela njihova:

data.arabic_text: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: Onaj ko bude uradio koliko trun dobra - vidjet će ga,

data.arabic_text: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: a onaj ko bude uradio i koliko trun zla - vidjet će ga.

metadata.title: French Translation - Rachid Maach
metadata.description: Translated by Rashid Ma’ash

data.translation: Lorsque la terre subira une violente secousse,
au point de rejeter ses fardeaux à sa surface[1],
data.footnotes: [1] Les morts enterrés en son sein, qui sortiront de terre le Jour de la résurrection.

data.translation: et que l’homme se demandera ce qui lui arrive,
ce Jour-là, elle livrera l’ensemble de ses secrets[2],
data.footnotes: [2] Les œuvres, bonnes ou mauvaises, accomplies à la surface de la terre par les hommes, selon nombre d’exégètes.

data.translation: se pliant ainsi à la volonté de ton Seigneur.

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
data.translation: Ce Jour-là, les hommes quitteront séparément le lieu de leur rassemblement afin que chacun découvre la rétribution de ses œuvres.

data.arabic_text: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: Quiconque aura accompli une once de bien le verra.

data.arabic_text: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: Et quiconque aura commis une once de mal le verra.

metadata.title: Spanish Translation - Isa Garcia
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Isa Garcia

data.translation: 1. Juro por los corceles que se lanzan relinchando
2. y arrancan chispas con sus cascos
3. y sorprenden al amanecer
4. levantando una nube de polvo,
5. e irrumpiendo en las filas del enemigo,
6. que el ser humano es ingrato con su Señor.
7. Y él mismo es testigo de ello,
8. porque tiene una codicia apasionada por los bienes materiales.

data.arabic_text: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
data.translation: 9. ¿Acaso no sabe que cuando se haga surgir a quienes están en las sepulturas
10. y se evidencie lo que hay en los corazones,
11. ese día su Señor estará bien informado de lo que hicieron?

metadata.title: German Translation - Frank Bubenheim
metadata.description: Translated by ‘Abdullah as-Sāmit (Frank Bubenheim) and Dr. Nadim Elias.

data.translation: Bei den schnaubend Rennenden,
den (mit ihren Hufen) Funken Schlagenden,
den am Morgen Angreifenden,
die darin Staub aufwirbeln,
die dann mitten in die Ansammlung eindringen!
Der Mensch ist seinem Herrn gegenüber wahrlich undankbar,
und er (selbst) ist darüber wahrlich Zeuge.
Und er ist in seiner Liebe zum (eigenen) Besten wahrlich heftig.

data.arabic_text: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
data.translation: Weiß er denn nicht? Wenn durchwühlt wird, was in den Gräbern ist,
und herausgeholt wird, was in den Brüsten ist,...
ihr Herr wird an jenem Tag ihrer wahrlich Kundig sein.

metadata.title: Dutch Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
metadata.description: Issued by the Dutch Islamic Center and developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center

data.translation: Als de aarde door haar (laatste) beving (krachtig) wordt geschud (ter aankondiging van de Laatste Dag).
En als de aarde zich binnenste buiten keert (en alles naar buiten werpt).
En als de (ongelovige) mens (verbaasd) zegt: “Wat gebeurt er nou?”
Die dag zal (de aarde) een verklaring afleggen (van al hetgeen er zich op haar heeft afgespeeld, goed of slecht).
Want jullie Heer heeft haar opgedragen (om te getuigen over de daden van elke dienaar en elk volk).

data.arabic_text: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
data.translation: Die dag zal de mens verschijnen in opgesplitste groepen (rechts voor het paradijs, links voor de hel), opdat zij hun daden (en beloning) mogen aanschouwen!

data.arabic_text: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: Dus wie goed heeft gedaan ter grootte van een atoom zal daar dan (de vruchten van) zien.

data.arabic_text: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
data.translation: En wie kwaad heeft gedaan ter grootte van een atoom zal (zijn aandeel daarvan ook) zien.

metadata.title: Turkish Translation - Dr. Ali Ozek and others
metadata.description: Translated by Ali Ozek and others, developed under the supervision of Rowad Translation Center. The original translation is available for expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Harıl harıl koşanlara, yemin ederim ki,
(nallarıyla) çakarak kıvılcım saçanlara yemin ederim ki,
(ansızın) sabah baskını yapanlara, yemin ederim ki,
orada tozu dumana katanlara, yemin ederim ki,
derken orada bir topluluğun ta ortasına girenlere yemin ederim ki,
insan, Rabbine karşı pek nankördür.
Şüphesiz buna kendisi de şahittir
ve o, mal sevgisine de aşırı derecede düşkündür.

data.arabic_text: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
data.translation: (İnsan) düşünmez mi ki, kabirlerde bulunanlar diriltilip dışarı atıldığı zaman,
Ve kalplerde gizlenenler ortaya konduğu zaman (hali ne olacak)!
Şüphesiz Rableri o gün onlardan tamamıyla haberdardır.

metadata.title: French Translation - Rachid Maach
metadata.description: Translated by Rashid Ma’ash

data.translation: Par les chevaux au galop haletant
dont les fers font jaillir des étincelles
lorsqu’ils chargent au point du jour
en soulevant un nuage de poussière
au moment de se jeter dans la mêlée !
L’homme en vérité est ingrat envers son Seigneur,
ingratitude qu’il reconnaît lui-même d’ailleurs,
Il voue aux biens terrestres un amour des plus ardents.

data.arabic_text: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
data.translation: Ne sait-il pas que les tombes seront vidées de leurs occupants
et que les secrets des cœurs seront étalés au grand jour ?
Ce Jour-là, leur Seigneur les jugera en connaissance de cause.

metadata.title: Bosnian Translation - Muhammad Mahanovic
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Mahanovic, developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center. The original translation is available for the purpose of expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Tako mi onih koji dahćući jure,
pa varnice frcaju
i zorom napadaju,
i tu dižu prašinu
pa tu svi zajedno u sredinu prodiru.
čovjek je, zaista, prema Gospodaru svome poricatelj veliki,
i sam je on, doista, svjedok toga,
i on je, zbilja, u ljubavi za dobrima dunjalučkim žestok.

data.arabic_text: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
data.translation: A zar on ne zna da će, kada kaburovi budu prevrnuti s onim što je u njima,
i kada iziđe na vidjelo ono što je u srcima,
Gospodar njihov Dan taj, sigurno, sve o njima znati?!

metadata.title: Dutch Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
metadata.description: Issued by the Dutch Islamic Center and developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center

data.translation: Bij de snuivende paarden.
Bij de vonken die eraf slaan (van hun hoeven).
En naar de overval bij de dageraad rennen.
En stofwolken opwerpen.
Doordringend tot degenen in het midden.
Waarlijk! De mens is ondankbaar tot zijn Heer.
En daar is hij zelf getuige van.
Hij heeft een intense liefde voor rijkdom.

data.arabic_text: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
data.translation: Weet hij niet dat wanneer de inhoud van de graven naar buiten wordt gebracht.
En bekend zal worden gemaakt wat er in de borsten zit.
Dan op die dag zal hun Heer goed bekend met hen zijn.

metadata.title: Spanish Translation - Isa Garcia
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Isa Garcia

data.translation: 1. La calamidad repentina.
2. ¿Qué es la calamidad repentina?
3. ¿Y qué te hará comprender la magnitud de la calamidad repentina?
4. Ese día la gente parecerá mariposas dispersas,
5. y las montañas copos de lana cardada.
6. Aquel cuyas obras buenas sean más pesadas en la balanza
7. gozará de una vida placentera.
8. En cambio, aquel cuyas obras buenas sean más livianas en la balanza,
9. su morada estará en el abismo.
10. ¿Y qué te hará comprender qué es el abismo?
11. Es un fuego abrasador.

metadata.title: English Translation - Noor International Center
metadata.description: Issued by Noor International Center.

data.translation: By the racers, panting,[1967]
data.footnotes: [1967] i.e., the horses bearing riders as they race to attack the enemy.

data.translation: And the producers of sparks [when] striking[1968]
data.footnotes: [1968] Their hoofs while galloping over rocky terrain.

data.translation: And the chargers at dawn,[1969]
data.footnotes: [1969] While the enemy is unaware.

data.translation: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
Arriving thereby in the center[1970] collectively,
data.footnotes: [1970] i.e., penetrating into the enemy ranks during a surprise attack.

data.translation: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
And indeed, he is to that a witness.[1971]
data.footnotes: [1971] Through his speech and his actions.

data.translation: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.

data.arabic_text: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
data.translation: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
And that within the breasts is obtained,[1972]
data.footnotes: [1972] i.e., when all secrets are made known.

data.translation: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.[1973]
data.footnotes: [1973] Fully acquainted and familiar with everything about each one of them.

metadata.title: French Translation - Rachid Maach
metadata.description: Translated by Rashid Ma’ash

data.translation: Le Grand choc !
Qu’est-ce que le Grand choc ?
Qui pourrait t’indiquer ce qu’est le Grand choc ?
Ce Jour-là, les hommes s’éparpilleront comme des papillons[1],
data.footnotes: [1] Ou : des sauterelles.

data.translation: et les montagnes auront, des flocons de laine cardée, la légèreté.
Celui dont la balance penchera du bon côté,
jouira au Paradis d’une éternelle félicité.
Quant à celui dont la balance penchera du mauvais côté,
il sera, dans l’Abîme, violemment précipité.
Mais qui pourrait te décrire sa réalité ?
Un feu ardent à jamais attisé !

metadata.title: Turkish Translation - Dr. Ali Ozek and others
metadata.description: Translated by Ali Ozek and others, developed under the supervision of Rowad Translation Center. The original translation is available for expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Çokluk kuruntusu sizi o derece oyaladı ki,
nihayet kabirleri ziyaret ettiniz.
Hayır! Yakında bileceksiniz!
Elbette yakında bileceksiniz!
Gerçek öyle değil ! Kesin bilgi ile bilmiş olsaydınız,
(orada) mutlaka cehennem ateşini görürdünüz.
Sonra ahirette onu çıplak gözle göreceksiniz.
Nihayet o gün (dünyada yararlandığınız) nimetlerden elbette ve elbette hesaba çekileceksiniz.

metadata.title: Turkish Translation - Dr. Ali Ozek and others
metadata.description: Translated by Ali Ozek and others, developed under the supervision of Rowad Translation Center. The original translation is available for expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Kapı çalan!
Nedir o kapı çalan?
O kapı çalanın ne olduğunu bilir misin?
İnsanların, ateşin etrafını sarmış pervaneler gibi olduğu,
dağların da atılmış renkli yüne dönüştüğü gündür (o Kâria!)
O gün kimin tartıları ameli ağır gelirse
işte o, hoşnut edici bir yaşayış içinde olur.
Kimin tartısı da hafif gelirse ,
işte onun anası (yeri, yurdu) Hâviye' dir.
Nedir o (Hâviye) bilir misin?
Kızgın ateş!

metadata.title: German Translation - Frank Bubenheim
metadata.description: Translated by ‘Abdullah as-Sāmit (Frank Bubenheim) and Dr. Nadim Elias.

data.translation: Das Verhängnis!
Was ist das Verhängnis?
Und was läßt dich wissen, was das Verhängnis ist?
Am Tag, da die Menschen wie flatternde Motten sein werden
und die Berge wie zerflockte gefärbte Wolle sein werden.
Was nun jemanden angeht, dessen Waagschalen schwer sind,
so wird er in einem zufriedenen Leben sein.
Was aber jemanden angeht, dessen Waagschalen leicht sind,
dessen Mutter wird ein Abgrund sein.
Und was läßt dich wissen, was das ist?
Ein sehr heißes Feuer.

metadata.title: English Translation - Noor International Center
metadata.description: Issued by Noor International Center.

data.translation: The Striking Calamity -
What is the Striking Calamity?
And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,[1975]
data.footnotes: [1975] The people will be as such after having been expelled from their graves.

data.translation: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.[1976]
data.footnotes: [1976] i.e., beginning to disintegrate.

data.translation: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
He will be in a pleasant life.
But as for one whose scales are light,
His refuge[1977] will be an abyss.[1978]
data.footnotes:
[1977] Literally, "mother" (a man's original refuge) , which will envelop him as in an embrace.
[1978] i.e., the pit of Hellfire.

data.translation: And what can make you know what that is?
It is a Fire, intensely hot.

metadata.title: Bosnian Translation - Muhammad Mahanovic
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Mahanovic, developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center. The original translation is available for the purpose of expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Udar zastrašujući!
Šta je Udar zastrašujući?
I šta ti znaš šta je Udar zastrašujući?
Dan taj ljudi će biti kao leptiri raštrkani,
a planine kao šarena vuna iščupana.
Onaj čija dobra djela budu teška,
u ugodnom životu će živjeti,
a onaj čija dobra djela budu lahka,
majka - utočište će mu bezdan biti.
A znaš li ti šta će to biti?
Vatra užarena!

metadata.title: Spanish Translation - Isa Garcia
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Isa Garcia

data.translation: 1. La competencia, y el afán de tener más y más, los dominan
2. hasta que la muerte los sorprenda y entren en la tumba.
3. ¡No deberían comportarse así! Ya se van a enterar [que obrar para la otra vida es superior].
4. Una vez más: ¡No deberían comportarse así! Ya se van a enterar [que obrar para la otra vida es superior].
5. Si hubieran sabido con certeza [el castigo de quienes consumen su vida en el afán de tener más y más, habrían cambiado el rumbo de sus vidas].
6. Habrán de ver el fuego del Infierno,
7. y lo verán con los ojos de la certeza.
8. Luego, ese día [del Juicio] se les preguntará por cada bendición que recibieron [durante la vida mundanal].

metadata.title: French Translation - Rachid Maach
metadata.description: Translated by Rashid Ma’ash

data.translation: La course aux richesses ne cessera de vous accaparer,
jusqu’au jour, inéluctable, où vous serez enterrés.
Mais vous saurez bientôt !
Oui, vous saurez bientôt !
Si seulement vous en aviez la certitude.
Vous verrez sans aucun doute le Brasier.
Oui, vous le verrez de vos propres yeux.
Vous devrez, ce Jour-là, répondre de vos jouissances terrestres[1].
data.footnotes: [1] Avez-vous répondu aux bienfaits de votre Seigneur par la gratitude ?

metadata.title: Dutch Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
metadata.description: Issued by the Dutch Islamic Center and developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center

data.translation: Het bonkende (het geluid van de dag des oordeels dat de harten angst geeft).
Wat is het uur dat geslagen is?
En wat laat jullie weten wat het uur dat geslagen is?
Dat is de dag waarop de mensheid lijkt op verspreide motten.
En de bergen zullen lijken op gekaarde wol.
Voor degenen wiens weegschaal zwaar is (aan Tawbah en goede daden).
Hij zal een plezierig leven leiden.
Maar voor degene wiens weegschaal licht is (zwaar in zijn eigen lusten volgen, licht in de profeet Mohammed vrede zij met hem volgen).
Zijn toevlucht is de hel.
En wat laat jullie weten wat dat is?
Dat is een heet laaiend vuur!

metadata.title: Bosnian Translation - Muhammad Mahanovic
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Mahanovic, developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center. The original translation is available for the purpose of expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Zaokuplja vas zgrtanje imovine
sve dok mezarja ne posjetite.
A ne treba tako, saznat ćete svakako!
I još jednom, ne treba tako! Saznat ćete sigurno!
Ne valja tako, kad biste vi znali pouzdano,
Oganj ćete, zaista, vidjeti!
I još jednom, doista ćete ga vidjeti sasvim jasno!
Zatim ćete Dan taj o blagodatima biti pitani sigurno!

metadata.title: German Translation - Frank Bubenheim
metadata.description: Translated by ‘Abdullah as-Sāmit (Frank Bubenheim) and Dr. Nadim Elias.

data.translation: Die Vermehrung lenkt euch ab,
bis ihr die Friedhöfe besucht.
Keineswegs! Ihr werdet (es noch) erfahren.
Abermals: Keineswegs! Ihr werdet (es noch) erfahren.
Keineswegs! Wenn ihr es nur mit dem Wissen der Gewißheit wüßtet!
Ihr werdet ganz gewiß den Höllenbrand sehen.
Abermals: Ihr werdet ihn mit dem Auge der Gewißheit sehen.
Hierauf werdet ihr an jenem Tag ganz gewiß nach der Wonne gefragt werden.

metadata.title: Turkish Translation - Dr. Ali Ozek and others
metadata.description: Translated by Ali Ozek and others, developed under the supervision of Rowad Translation Center. The original translation is available for expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Asra yemin ederim ki
insan gerçekten ziyan içindedir.

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
data.translation: Bundan ancak iman edip iyi ameller işleyenler, birbirlerine hakkı tavsiye edenler ve sabrı tavsiye edenler müstesnadır.

metadata.title: Dutch Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
metadata.description: Issued by the Dutch Islamic Center and developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center

data.translation: Het vermeerderen van wereldlijke zaken, leidt jullie af (vandaar dat velen geen kennis opdoen).
Tot jullie de graven bezoeken.
Nee! Jullie zullen het te weten komen!
Nogmaals nee! Jullie zullen het te weten komen!
Nee, als jullie het zeker zouden weten.
Waarlijk, je zult het laaiende vuur zien!
Dan zullen jullie het met een zeker oog zien
Dan op die dag, zullen jullie over de genietingen ondervraagd worden.

metadata.title: English Translation - Noor International Center
metadata.description: Issued by Noor International Center.

data.translation: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
Until you visit the graveyards.[1980]
data.footnotes: [1980] i.e., remain in them temporarily, meaning until the Day of Resurrection.

data.translation: No! You are going to know.
Then, no! You are going to know.
No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...[1981]
data.footnotes: [1981] The conclusion of this verse is estimated to be "...you would not have been distracted from preparing for the Hereafter."

data.translation: You will surely see the Hellfire.
Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.[1982]
data.footnotes: [1982] i.e., with actual eyesight.

data.translation: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.[1983]
data.footnotes: [1983] i.e., the comforts of worldly life and whether you were grateful to Allāh for His blessings.

metadata.title: Spanish Translation - Isa Garcia
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Isa Garcia

data.translation: 1. Juro por el tiempo[1]
data.footnotes: [1] Algunos exégetas sugieren que no es simplemente el tiempo o el transcurso del tiempo, sino que se trataría específicamente del momento de la tarde (‘asr عصر), ya que en otros versículos del Corán también se mencionan estos tiempos de las oraciones, como por ejemplo el amanecer (fayr فجر).

data.translation: 2. que los seres humanos están en la perdición,

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
data.translation: 3. excepto aquellos que crean, obren rectamente, y se aconsejen mutuamente con la verdad y con la paciencia [ante las adversidades].

metadata.title: English Translation - Noor International Center
metadata.description: Issued by Noor International Center.

data.translation: By time,[1985]
data.footnotes: [1985] An oath in which Allāh swears by time throughout the ages.

data.translation: Indeed, mankind is in loss,

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
data.translation: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

metadata.title: Dutch Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
metadata.description: Issued by the Dutch Islamic Center and developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center

data.translation: (Allah zweert) bij de tijd.
Waarlijk, de (ongelovige) mens is verliezend (en in een staat van zelfvernietiging)!

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
data.translation: Behalve degenen die (in Allah en Zijn boodschapper) geloven (dus kennis opdoen) en goede daden verrichten (ernaar handelen), en elkaar aansporen tot de waarheid (en gehoorzaamheid aan Allah), en elkaar aansporen tot geduld.

metadata.title: Turkish Translation - Dr. Ali Ozek and others
metadata.description: Translated by Ali Ozek and others, developed under the supervision of Rowad Translation Center. The original translation is available for expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Arkadan çekiştirmeyi, yüze karşı eğlenmeyi âdet edinen herkesin vay haline!
O ki, mal toplamış ve onu sayıp durmuştur.
(O), malının kendisini ebedi kılacağını zanneder.
Hayır! Andolsun ki o, Hutame'ye atılacaktır.
Hutame'nin ne olduğunu bilir misin?
Allah'ın, tutuşturulmuş, ateşidir.
(Yandıkça) tırmanıp kalplerin ta üstüne çıkan
ve o vaziyette o (ateş) üzerlerine kapatılmıştır.
Onlar (bu ateşin içinde) uzatılmış sütunlara bağlanmışlar.

metadata.title: French Translation - Rachid Maach
metadata.description: Translated by Rashid Ma’ash

data.translation: Par le Temps !
L’homme, en vérité, court à sa perte,

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
data.translation: à l’exception de ceux qui croient, font le bien, se recommandent mutuellement la vraie foi et se recommandent mutuellement la constance.

metadata.title: German Translation - Frank Bubenheim
metadata.description: Translated by ‘Abdullah as-Sāmit (Frank Bubenheim) and Dr. Nadim Elias.

data.translation: Wehe jedem Stichler und Nörgler,
der Besitz zusammenträgt und ihn zählt und immer wieder zählt,
wobei er meint, daß sein Besitz ihn ewig leben ließe!
Keineswegs! Er wird ganz gewiß in al-Hutama geworfen werden.
Was läßt dich wissen, was al-Hutama ist?
(Sie ist) Allahs entfachtes Feuer,
das Einblick in die Herzen gewinnt.
Gewiß, es wird sie einschließen
in langgestreckten Säulen.

metadata.title: Bosnian Translation - Muhammad Mahanovic
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Mahanovic, developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center. The original translation is available for the purpose of expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Tako mi vremena,
doista je čovjek na gubitku,

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
data.translation: samo nisu oni koji vjeruju i dobra djela čine, i koji jedni drugima Istinu preporučuju i koji jedni drugima preporučuju strpljenje.

metadata.title: French Translation - Rachid Maach
metadata.description: Translated by Rashid Ma’ash

data.translation: Malheur à tout médisant qui ne cesse de calomnier,
préoccupé à amasser des richesses et à les compter,
s’imaginant que sa fortune lui assurera l’immortalité.
C’est plutôt dans la Houtamah[1] qu’il sera précipité.
data.footnotes: [1] L’un des noms de l’Enfer tiré de l’arabe « Hatama » qui signifie : briser, broyer, écraser.

data.translation: Mais qui pourrait bien te décrire sa réalité ?
C’est le feu d’Allah à tout jamais attisé,
pénétrant jusqu’aux cœurs des damnés
et qui se refermera sur les réprouvés,
en d’interminables colonnes enflammées.

metadata.title: English Translation - Noor International Center
metadata.description: Issued by Noor International Center.

data.translation: Woe to every scorner and mocker
Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.[1987]
data.footnotes: [1987] Rather than spending in the way of Allāh.

data.translation: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.[1988]
data.footnotes: [1988] i.e., Hellfire, which crushes and destroys all that enters it.

data.translation: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
It is the fire of Allāh, [eternally] fueled,
Which mounts directed at the hearts.[1989]
data.footnotes: [1989] Covering them and penetrating them.

data.translation: Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them
In extended columns.[1990]
data.footnotes: [1990] Interpreted to be either columns of fire or columns of iron to which are chained the inmates of Hell.

metadata.title: Dutch Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
metadata.description: Issued by the Dutch Islamic Center and developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center

data.translation: Wee voor de lasteraars (de roddelaars), degenen die kwaadspreken (door de fouten op te zoeken van hun broeders en nog veel erger; bij de mensen van kennis).
Die de rijkdom verzamelt en deze telt.
Hij denkt dat hij door deze rijkdom voor altijd zal bestaan!
Nee! Waarlijk, hij zal in het verpletterende vuur gegooid worden.
En wat laat jullie weten wat het verpletterende vuur is?
Het vuur dat Allah heeft aangestoken.
Dat naar hun harten opspringt.
Waarlijk het zal hen insluiten (zoals zij ook zichzelf insloten door zonden zonder Tawbah).
In pilaren die zich uitstrekken.

metadata.title: Bosnian Translation - Muhammad Mahanovic
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Mahanovic, developed under the supervision of Rowwad Translation Center. The original translation is available for the purpose of expressing opinion, evaluation, and continuous development.

data.translation: Teško svakom klevetniku podrugljivcu,
koji blago gomila i prebrojava ga,
i misli da će ga blago njegovo besmrtnim učiniti.
A ne treba tako! On će sigurno biti bačen u Hutamu!
A znaš li ti šta je Hutama?
Vatra Allahova razbuktala,
koja će do srca dopirati.
Ona će nad njima biti zatvorena
plamenim izduženim stubovima.

metadata.title: German Translation - Frank Bubenheim
metadata.description: Translated by ‘Abdullah as-Sāmit (Frank Bubenheim) and Dr. Nadim Elias.

data.translation: Beim Zeitalter!
Der Mensch befindet sich wahrlich in Verlust,

data.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
data.translation: außer denjenigen, die glauben und rechtschaffene Werke tun und einander die Wahrheit eindringlich empfehlen und einander die Standhaftigkeit eindringlich empfehlen.

metadata.title: Spanish Translation - Isa Garcia
metadata.description: Translated by Muhammad Isa Garcia

data.translation: 1. ¡Ay del castigo que les aguarda al difamador y al calumniador,
2. al que acumula bienes materiales y los cuenta una y otra vez,
3. creyendo que su riqueza lo hará vivir eternamente!
4. Por el contrario, serán arrojados en un fuego demoledor.
5. ¿Y qué te hará comprender lo que es un fuego demoledor?
6. Es un fuego encendido por Dios
7. cuyo dolor alcanza los corazones.
8. El Infierno se cerrará en torno a ellos
9. con columnas inmensas.
